38.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Organ) A. Judiciary B. Legislature C. Executive List II (Function) 1. Makes Laws 2. Interprets Laws 3. Implements Laws
38.explanation: The legislature makes laws, the executive implements them and the judiciary interprets them.

39.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Level of government) A. Local government B. Central (Union) government C. State government List II (Scope) 1. Village/Town 2. Whole Country 3. Specific State
39.explanation: Local government serves a village or town, the Union government the whole country and the state government one state.

55.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Level of government) A. Local government B. Union government C. State government List II (Function) 1. Provides local services 2. Handles national issues 3. Manages state affairs
55.explanation: Local bodies provide local services, the Union government handles national issues and the state government manages state affairs.

61.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Official) A. Mayor B. Prime Minister C. President List II (Role) 1. Head of state 2. Leads the municipal corporation 3. Head of the government
61.explanation: The Mayor leads the municipal corporation, the Prime Minister heads the Union government and the President is head of state.

65.question: Match List I with List II: List I (Official) A. Mayor B. Chief Minister C. Prime Minister List II (Leads) 1. Leads the municipal corporation 2. Leads the state government 3. Leads the central government
65.explanation: The Mayor leads the municipal corporation, the Chief Minister the state government and the Prime Minister the Union government.
